name: driver
title: Driver
description: Look up one driver: who they are, their IDs and contacts, and their scorecards, routes, timecards and more.

Section.description: A section of the answer, from one feature's data.

driver.description: The driver: a name or part of one, an ID, email address, phone number, or their code.

from.description: The first day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the DSP's own time; the range ends today unless `to` says otherwise.

to.description: The last day, YYYY-MM-DD; only with `from`.

last_days.description: The last this many days, today included, 1 to 31; the last 7 when no days are given.

sections.description: The sections to answer; every one when left out.

dsp.description: The DSP, by its name or ID. Leave it out when this connection reaches one DSP.

Identity.description: Who they are, as the DSP's directory tells people apart.

code.description: Theirs for good: give it as `driver` to ask about them again.

names.description: Every way their sources write their name, the one shown first.

role.description: driver, helper, office for management, or former for someone who has left.

title.description: What they do in management, when someone gave them a title: owner, ops_manager, fleet_manager, dispatch, hr_manager or manager.

ids.description: Every ID they hold, by its source, such as amazon for transporter IDs.

confirmed.description: Whether someone confirmed who they are, rather than a match.

Scorecards.description: Their weekly scorecards, each week Sunday to Saturday.

ids.description: The IDs of theirs it was read under; with none, it knows nothing of them.

collected.description: The first week's Sunday and the last week's Saturday collected, or null for none yet.

unknown_weeks.description: The weeks overlapping the days that aren't collected, as Amazon names them: unknown, not missing.

weeks.description: Their scorecard for each week overlapping the days, the oldest first.

packages.description: The packages those scorecards list for them, the oldest week first, the newest 40 at most.

more_packages.description: How many more packages there are than listed.

Collected.description: The first day and the last a feature has collected, YYYY-MM-DD in the DSP's own time.

week.description: Its week, as Amazon names it (2026-W38).

overall_tier.description: As Amazon writes it, such as Platinum.

delivered.description: The packages they delivered that week.

metrics.description: Each metric it grades, in the scorecard's order.

name.description: seatbelt, speeding, distractions, following_distance, sign_signal_violations, cdf_dpmo, ced, rts, dsb or pod.

value.description: What it measured, a rate, DPMO or count, as Amazon writes it.

Package.description: A package a scorecard lists for them.

week.description: The scorecard week it counts in.

date.description: Its own day: delivered for a concession or feedback, planned for a return.

impacting.description: Whether it counts against the scorecard, or null when Amazon doesn't say.

PackageKind.description: concession: reported missing or delivered badly; return: brought back to the station; feedback: the customer's.

Daily.description: Amazon's Daily Quality and Day Safety of theirs, day by day.

ids.description: The IDs of theirs it was read under; with none, it knows nothing of them.

collected.description: The first day collected and the last, or null for none yet.

unknown_days.description: The days asked that aren't collected: unknown, rather than nothing reported.

days.description: Each day Amazon reported something of theirs, by day and then ID, the oldest first.

more_days.description: How many older days are left out to fit.

more_returned.description: How many more returned packages there are than listed.

more_events.description: How many more safety events there are than listed.

Day.description: What Amazon reported of one of their IDs on one day. A part it reported nothing of is null or empty.

returned.description: Each package they returned to the station.

events.description: Each safety event, as assessed once Amazon has, else as reported live.

Quality.description: The day's Daily Quality, each number as Amazon gives it; a rate is a fraction of one.

pod_opportunities.description: Deliveries that needed a photo, and those that had a good one.

Safety.description: The day's safety events, counted by kind.

Feedback.description: The customers' feedback on the day's deliveries.

negatives.description: Each reason for negative feedback that isn't zero.

Count.description: A count, named by Amazon's field for it, such as never_received_delivery_cnt.

concerns.description: Each kind of behavior that isn't zero.

Returns.description: The day's packages returned to the station: in all, those they could have delivered, and those exempted.

Returned.description: A package returned to the station.

reason.description: Why, as Amazon codes it, such as BUSINESS CLOSED.

impacting.description: Whether it counts against their delivery completion.

coaching.description: What Amazon coaches them to do about it.

kind.description: What happened, as Amazon names it, such as Speeding.

started.description: When it started, in local time, as Amazon writes it.

impacting.description: Whether it counts against them, once assessed.

assessed.description: Whether Amazon has assessed it, rather than only reporting it live.

ids.description: The IDs of theirs it was read under; with none, it knows nothing of them.

collected.description: The first day collected and the last, or null for none yet.

unknown_days.description: The days asked that aren't collected: unknown, rather than days they didn't drive.

partial_days.description: The days read while under way: their counts are so far, and a day without a route proves nothing.

routes.description: Each route they drove, the oldest first; a day may have several, and any other day collected whole they didn't drive.

more_routes.description: How many older routes are left out to fit.

more_undelivered.description: How many more undelivered packages there are than listed.

Route.description: A route they drove, its times HH:MM in the DSP's own time, with the date before one on a later day.

status.description: How Amazon says it went, such as COMPLETE.

progress.description: How Amazon says it kept up, such as ON_TIME or BEHIND.

delivered.description: The packages to drop off that were delivered, and that weren't.

removed.description: The packages taken off the route, as when another driver rescued them.

undelivered.description: Each package to drop off that wasn't delivered, in the order attempted.

Undelivered.description: A package to drop off that wasn't delivered.

state.description: Where Amazon says it ended, such as UNDELIVERABLE.

reason.description: Why, as Amazon gives it, such as BUSINESS_CLOSED.

attempted.description: When it was attempted, as the route's times are.

Timecards.description: Their timecards, as Paycom records them.

ids.description: The IDs of theirs it was read under; with none, it knows nothing of them.

collected.description: The first day collected and the last, or null for none yet.

unknown_days.description: The days asked that no collection has reached: unknown, rather than days off.

partial_days.description: The days read while under way: a timecard there is so far, and a day without one may not be a day off.

days.description: Each day with punches or hours, by day and then ID, the oldest first; any other day neither unknown nor partial was a day off.

more_days.description: How many older days are left out to fit.

status.description: Paycom's word for it, such as Complete, Missing punch or No punches.

hours.description: The hours Paycom reports, which leave out meals and may include paid leave.

worked_minutes.description: The minutes on the clock between complete punches, meals left out; null when the punches can't say.

meals.description: Each meal break, as punched out and back in.

review.description: Whether the punches need someone to look: unlabeled, unreadable or out of order.

time.description: HH:MM in the DSP's own time, or null when Paycom's isn't a clock.

next_day.description: Whether it fell on the day after the timecard's, as at the end of a night's shift.

PunchKind.description: What a punch says: in or out for the day, out or back in for a meal, or unlabeled.

out.description: When it started and ended, HH:MM; null for a punch missing.

minutes.description: How long it was; null unless both punches are there and in order.

Roster.description: What Amazon's roster says of them.

ids.description: The IDs of theirs it was read under; with none, it knows nothing of them.

collected.description: When the roster was last collected, RFC 3339 in UTC, or null for never.

associates.description: Each of their IDs a roster has listed, as the newest to list it did.

Associate.description: One of their IDs, as the newest roster to list it did.

listed.description: Whether the newest roster lists them; one it stopped listing keeps what the last to list them said.

status.description: ACTIVE or INACTIVE, as Amazon writes it.

roles.description: What they may do, such as Driver or Helper.

qualifications.description: The vans and kinds of work they're qualified for, such as CDV or EDV.

license_expires.description: The day their driver's license expires, when Amazon has it.

last_listed.description: When a roster last listed them, RFC 3339 in UTC.

Chat.description: Their accounts in the DSP's chat workspaces.

ids.description: The IDs of theirs it was read under; with none, it knows nothing of them.

ChatAccount.description: One account in one of the DSP's workspaces.

user.description: Their member ID in the workspace, U…, as a mention (<@U…>) names them.

display_name.description: The name they go by there, when it isn't the name on their profile.

broken.description: Whether the workspace's access broke: the rest is as it last stood.

Inspections.description: Their DVIC pre-trip inspections shorter than the minimum: DVIC records only these, so none on a day collected is none short.

ids.description: The IDs of theirs it was read under; with none, it knows nothing of them.

collected.description: The first day collected and the last, or null for none yet.

unknown_days.description: The days asked outside what's collected: unknown, rather than none short.

inspections.description: Each short inspection, the newest first, 30 at most.

more_inspections.description: How many more short inspections there are than listed.

Inspection.description: An inspection shorter than its minimum.

start_time.description: When it started, as Amazon's report gives it, with no time zone.

vehicle_type.description: CV, CDV or SV: 90 seconds is the minimum for the first two, 300 for a step van.

from.description: The first day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the DSP's own time.

to.description: The last day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the DSP's own time.

daily.description: Amazon's Daily Quality and Day Safety of theirs, day by day.

timecards.description: Their timecards, as Paycom records them.

roster.description: What Amazon's roster says of them.

chat.description: Their accounts in the DSP's chat workspaces.

inspections.description: Their DVIC pre-trip inspections shorter than the minimum.

trimmed.description: Whether any list was cut short, each counting what it left out: ask for fewer days or sections to see the rest.

name: dvic_short_inspections
title: DVIC short inspections
description: Find drivers whose DVIC pre-trip inspections were shorter than the minimum.

Week.description: A week, Sunday to Saturday, as the DVIC page shows it.

drivers.description: Drivers, each by name, part of one, an ID, email address or phone number; none for everyone.

date.description: One day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the DSP's own time.

from.description: The first day of a range, YYYY-MM-DD; the range ends today unless `to` says otherwise.

to.description: The last day of a range, YYYY-MM-DD; only with `from`.

last_days.description: The last this many days, today included, 1 to 366: 3 is today and the two days before.

week.description: A week, Sunday to Saturday: `this` one so far, or `last` one.

dsp.description: The DSP, by its name or ID. Leave it out when this connection reaches one DSP.

Collected.description: The days DVIC's collected reports cover.

Driver.description: A driver short of the minimum on the days searched.

days.description: The days they were short, oldest first.

most_short_by_seconds.description: How many seconds short their shortest inspection was of its minimum.

Inspection.description: An inspection shorter than its minimum.

start_time.description: When it started, as Amazon's report gives it, with no time zone.

vehicle_type.description: CV, CDV or SV: 90 seconds is the minimum for the first two, 300 for a step van.

from.description: The first day searched, YYYY-MM-DD, in the DSP's own time.

to.description: The last day searched, YYYY-MM-DD, in the DSP's own time.

collected.description: The days DVIC has collected, or null for none yet; a day outside is unknown, not clean.

complete.description: Whether every day searched is within what is collected.

drivers.description: Each driver short of the minimum on the days searched, the most short inspections first.

inspections.description: The short inspections, newest first, at most 100.

more.description: How many more short inspections there are than listed: ask for fewer days to see them.

not_found.description: The drivers asked for whom DVIC has never recorded short of the minimum.

name: get_profile
title: Current Dispatch profile
description: Return the stable Dispatch profile represented by this request's authenticated credentials.

id.description: Opaque profile identifier, stable across refresh and reconnection.

name.description: Display name for the authenticated profile.

name: support_ticket_diagnostics
title: AI Support ticket diagnostics
description: Read an AI Support ticket's runtime and recent provider/job health at its DSP.

ticket_id.description: The AI Support ticket ID; the ticket must belong to this call's DSP.

dsp.description: The DSP, by its name or ID. Leave it out when this connection reaches one DSP.

diagnostics.description: Ticket-derived runtime and bounded provider/job health; no reports, names or employee records.

name: whoami
title: This connection
description: Return this connection's name, access and expiry, the time now, and each DSP it reaches with the DSP's own date today.

tools.description: The tools it may use now, where a DSP it reaches has them on, each to read or change.

AgentAccess.description:
What an agent key may do: look things up, or also run collections and test
connections.

ToolLevel.description: What a key or app may do with a tool: nothing, read, or read and change.

AgentWhoamiDsp.description: A DSP as an agent sees it: its local date, so "today" and "yesterday" mean the DSP's.
